name: trulycricket
description: Live cricket scores, scorecards, series tables and player profiles in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
TrulyCricket brings live cricket into ChatGPT. Ask for live scores, a match's scorecard, a series' points table and fixtures or a player's profile, and TrulyCricket answers with clear visual cards right in the conversation.

What you can ask for:
- Live, recent and upcoming matches in international, franchise and domestic cricket, with scores, the match status and breaks in play (stumps, lunch, tea, rain).
- Scorecards: innings totals, batting and bowling figures, extras and the toss; compact in the chat, in full with one tap.
- Series: points tables (one per group for World Cups and other group stages) and fixtures, with a tap through to any match's scorecard.
- Players: country, role, batting and bowling style, date and place of birth.

Scores come from CricketData.org and can lag live play by a few minutes; every card says when its data was fetched. TrulyCricket only reads public cricket data: no sign-in, no ads, no purchases, and it never asks for personal information.

TrulyCricket is an independent project by Yuvraj Barsara. It is not affiliated with the ICC, any cricket board, team, league or data provider.
defaultPrompt: What are the live cricket scores right now?
Show the points table of the Men's T20 World Cup 2026
Show the scorecard of the Men's T20 World Cup 2026 final

positive.prompt: Show me the live cricket scores.
positive.expected_behavior: A TrulyCricket scores card lists the matches in play with both teams, their scores, the match status and a LIVE pill (or STUMPS, LUNCH, TEA for a break), with a Show all button when there are more. If no match is live at that moment, the card says there are no live matches. ChatGPT replies briefly without repeating every score.

positive.description: Points table of a series in groups
positive.prompt: Show the points table of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: A series card shows a Groups tab with one points table per group (Super 8 Group 1 and 2, then Groups A to D, with played, won, lost and points), a note that the tables are worked out from the match results, and a Matches tab listing the fixtures and results.

positive.prompt: Show the scorecard of the final of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: A compact scorecard card shows the final, its result, the latest innings total with its top batters and bowlers, and a Full scorecard button that opens both innings with batting and bowling tables, extras and the toss.

positive.prompt: Show me the upcoming cricket fixtures.
positive.expected_behavior: A TrulyCricket scores card opens on the Upcoming filter and lists the next fixtures with both teams, the series and the start date and time in the user's time zone, with a Show all button when there are more.

positive.prompt: Tell me about the cricketer Virat Kohli: his role and batting style.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT answers in text with Virat Kohli's country (India), playing role and batting and bowling styles, as returned by TrulyCricket's player profile.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in London today?
Who won the 2022 FIFA World Cup final?
Write a short poem about summer holidays.

publication.release_notes: First release. Live, recent and upcoming matches with scores and breaks in play; scorecards, compact in the chat and in full with one tap; series points tables (one per group for group stages) and fixtures; player profiles.
